items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: And, suddenly, we heard he died at a big funeral for him. We played at the funeral.

ctx.x: Ken Owens, he was a boy wonder, 16, 17 years old. He was playing beautiful sounding stuff on cornet. He just never developed, unfortunately. He's still occasionally playing very promising sort of stuff, but not, he's just never developed. He's now, he must be in his mid-thirties. He's just never made it. He's around your age, huh? Yes, yes. He, I just can't understand it.
And Ian Burns, is he the one that's playing yet?

No, he, unfortunately, he was a fine pianist, strong sort of honky-tonk sort of style. And, unfortunately, he died suddenly, something caught in his throat or something. Oh. Yes, it was very, he was playing with the Frank Johnson band. And, suddenly, we heard he died at a big funeral for him. We played at the funeral.
